# G'MIC 4.0.5 standard library: filters Patchy leaves out, with the reason.
# Generated by scripts/dev/gmic/build_allowlist.py, then maintained by hand.
# One filter id per line; text after white space is a comment. See docs/gmic.md.
gui_download_all_data  # About / Download External Data: information or test page
fx_gmicky  # About / Gmicky - Roddy: information or test page
fx_frame_seamless  # Arrays & Tiles / Make Seamless [Patch-Based]: patch-based algorithm
fx_shuffle_patches  # Arrays & Tiles / Shuffle Patches: patch-based algorithm
fx_rotate_tileable  # Arrays & Tiles / Tileable Rotation: fails on the 48x40 test image (cause not yet understood)
fx_linify  # Artistic / Linify: fails on the 48x40 test image (cause not yet understood)
fx_stylize  # Artistic / Stylize: patch-based style transfer
fx_colorize_interactive  # Black & White / Colorize [Interactive]: interactive segmentation or colorization
fx_autofill_lineart  # Black & White / Colorize Lineart [Auto-Fill]: interactive segmentation or colorization
fx_colorize_lineart  # Black & White / Colorize Lineart [Propagation]: interactive segmentation or colorization
fx_colorize_lineart_smart  # Black & White / Colorize Lineart [Smart Coloring]: interactive segmentation or colorization
fx_clut_from_ab  # Colors / CLUT from After - Before Layers: needs two input layers but declares the active layer as its input
fx_mask_color  # Colors / Color Mask [Interactive]: needs a window (interactive)
fx_curves_interactive  # Colors / Curves: needs a window (interactive)
fx_extract_foreground  # Contours / Extract Foreground [Interactive]: interactive segmentation or colorization
fx_morph_interactive  # Deformations / Morph [Interactive]: needs a window (interactive)
fx_seamcarve  # Deformations / Seamcarve: content-aware resizing
fx_warp_interactive  # Deformations / Warp [Interactive]: needs a window (interactive)
fx_simulate_grain  # Degradations / Add Grain: needs a data file G'MIC downloads
fx_blur_dof  # Degradations / Blur [Depth-of-Field]: per-pixel blur level around a focus point (not offered, docs/patent-research-gmic.md)
fx_blur_motion  # Degradations / Blur [Motion]: blur kernel drawn as a user path (not offered, docs/patent-research-gmic.md)
fx_watermark_visible  # Degradations / Visible Watermark: needs a font G'MIC downloads
fx_blend_seamless  # Layers / Blend [Seamless]: gradient-domain compositing
fx_light_leaks  # Lights & Shadows / Light Leaks: needs a data file G'MIC downloads
syntexturize  # Patterns / Resynthesize Texture [FFT]: texture synthesis
syntexturize_matchpatch  # Patterns / Resynthesize Texture [Patch-Based]: patch-based algorithm; texture synthesis
fx_equation_parametric  # Rendering / Equation Plot [Parametric]: does not finish in 10 s at default settings on a 48x40 image
fx_equation_plot  # Rendering / Equation Plot [Y=f(X)]: does not finish in 10 s at default settings on a 48x40 image
fx_generate_random_portrait  # Rendering / Generate Random Portrait: network
fx_quick_copyright  # Rendering / Quick Copyright: needs a font G'MIC downloads
fx_denoise  # Repair / Denoise [CNN]: neural network
fx_inpaint_holes  # Repair / Inpaint [Holes]: inpainting
fx_inpaint_morpho  # Repair / Inpaint [Morphological]: inpainting
fx_inpaint_matchpatch  # Repair / Inpaint [Multi-Scale]: inpainting
fx_inpaint_patch  # Repair / Inpaint [Patch-Based]: inpainting; patch-based algorithm
fx_inpaint_pde  # Repair / Inpaint [Transport-Diffusion]: inpainting
fx_smooth_patch  # Repair / Smooth [Patch-Based]: patch-based algorithm
fx_smooth_patchpca  # Repair / Smooth [Patch-PCA]: patch-based algorithm
fx_scale2x_cnn  # Repair / Upscale [CNN2x]: neural network
fx_custom_code  # Various / Custom Code [Full]: runs G'MIC code typed by the user
fx_custom_code#2  # Various / Custom Code [Global]: runs G'MIC code typed by the user
fx_custom_code#3  # Various / Custom Code [Local]: runs G'MIC code typed by the user
fx_output_565  # Various / Export RGB-565 File: only writes a file, and into the working folder at its default name; exporting is File > Export's job
fx_gmic_demos  # Various / Games & Demos: window or interactive input
fx_import_image  # Various / Import Data: only loads a file the user names, which is File > Open's job
fx_intarsia  # Various / Intarsia: only writes an HTML file and needs an output folder to run
